# `⍬` — Empty vector

`⍬` is an empty approximate numeric vector: `0⍴0`. Empty brackets, `[]`, give the same value.

```apl
⍴⍬                 ⍝ ,0ₓ
⍬,1 2              ⍝ 1 2
[]≡⍬               ⍝ 1ₓ
```

Other empty types retain their prototypes.

```apl
3↑0⍴0x             ⍝ 0ₓ 0ₓ 0ₓ
3↑""               ⍝ "   "
```
